images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single polished landscape promotional artwork for the personal website portfolio of the indie game Mosslume, wide 16:9, full bleed.
Input image: the supplied Mosslume title artwork is a visual style reference, NOT a layout to screenshot. Match its detailed crisp pixel-art, compact rounded tree shapes, original friendly tiny villagers, purple-roof timber buildings, lush foliage, coastal world and warm/cool lighting palette. Create a fresh scene at closer scale with absolutely no lettering or interface.
Primary request: a beautiful living coastal camp at blue-hour dusk. A natural curved dirt footpath runs between layered lush round-canopy trees toward one cozy purple-roof wooden cottage and a small sea-facing timber jetty. Three small original villagers in practical brown/green farm clothing spend time around a glowing campfire, one bringing a bundle of wood, one sitting on a stump; a small tawny dog rests nearby. Show a modest vegetable patch, stacked firewood, workbench, one wooden chest, mixed ferns and pale wildflowers integrated naturally, with consistent tiny character/object scale. Raised irregular mossy rock shoreline, visible tiered earth edge, turquoise shallows blending into rich navy ocean, delicate waves and amber reflections. Distant island silhouettes, first stars, subtly drifting smoke and a few fireflies.
Composition: landscape illustration, immersive elevated three-quarter view, environment dominates with approachable characters clearly visible but small. Campfire/cottage form one coherent focal area; sea and curving shore create breathing room; beautifully balanced for a website showcase card. No reserved menu zone.
Lighting: golden fire and windows illuminate nearby foliage, footpath and wooden objects with directional shadows; twilight indigo canopy shadows, dark cool ocean, luminous turquoise shallows; retain clear pixel clusters, restrained glow only at actual sources, no blur over detailed subjects.
Constraints: original environment belonging to the supplied artwork's world. Sharp deliberate pixel texture and crisp contours, premium indie-game promotional pixel illustration, no 3D, no painterly smudges, no screen frame. NO logo, NO title, NO text of any kind, NO lettering, NO buttons, NO menu, NO HUD, NO dialogue bubbles, NO watermark, NO game interface. Single continuous complete image, not a collage or contact sheet.

Subtle ancient rounded moss-covered stone arch half hidden among trees on the right suggests exploration without readable runes or lettering. All small relative to the environment with consistent realistic-to-the-world ground contacts, practical simple clothes, no extravagant heroes. One pauses at the bridge, one examines a mushroom, one looks toward the arch. No combat.

View fills the frame naturally, no reserved title/menu zone, no lake cottage or large title typography. Clear varied height through banks, ledges and roots while retaining coherent ground scale.
Lighting: rich cool indigo perimeter, soft luminous cyan reflections from mushrooms into the water and nearby leaves, a restrained warm amber lantern pool and clear directional contact shadows. Detailed legible shadows, no overexposed neon and no fog/blur hiding the art. Deliberate crisp square pixel clusters and dark clean edges throughout, matching the reference premium pixel illustration, not a 3D render or soft oil painting.
Constraints: NO text, NO logo, NO title, NO words, NO labels, NO menu, NO buttons, NO HUD, NO health bars, NO dialogue bubbles, NO watermark, NO browser or operating system frame. Single complete artwork, not collage, not sprite sheet.
